sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static article/blog layout: a top navigation bar with four direct links, a title/date/content area, and footer-like links. There is no visible evidence of a hamburger trigger, submenu, sticky behavior, forms, search, tabs, accordions, modals, notifications, or progressive loading. The desktop sketch shows the same direct-link navigation expanded horizontally, while the mobile sketch still appears to show inline top navigation rather than a collapsed menu. Any JavaScript would therefore be optional enhancement rather than implied by the sketches.
